label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee/surprise feast for the mayor's forty years: 200 fresh loaves and lanterns arranged in the great hall for day 1 at 18:00. Baker produced the bread and was knowingly involved; secretary facilitated a misleadingly ordinary appointment and escort while being explicitly asked to keep the purpose secret, though the record primarily shows her role as escort rather than feast logistics. The mayor was not told the true purpose before the preparations were complete; by the end of the record he has not yet been escorted into the hall or informed of the surprise.
